## 主张 Claim

对每个依存网上的每个平衡流，恢复是一条定律：一步共同盈余使条件水平至少升一；在水平不低于起点的每一步，各形成共同给予多于取走时，m − 水平 步使水平回到 m（Flow.restores）。支持门控规律族的每个规律都是其静态网上的这样一个流（SupportGated.balances），所以它恢复维持所需是实例（SupportGated.repair_restores，命题即 repair_restores_sustaining_support）：在既有支持门控规律中，起初仍受支持的贡献路径若在缺口步数内持续有正净贡献，便保持自身支持并恢复维持活动所需的条件。若两项活动都失去支持，实际水平此后不变，即使后续输入表仍列有贡献。两个实际取用历史从同一初值出发、后续输入相同，却分别恢复与不恢复；恢复历史既非全程更新型，也非永久消耗型；其受支持的脉冲是该定律的实例（SupportGated.pulse_restores）。 / For every balanced flow on every web, restoration is a law: a step of joint surplus raises a condition's level by at least one, and where the formations give jointly more than they take at each step at which the level is not below where it started, m − level steps bring the level back to m (Flow.restores). Every law of the support-gated family is such a flow on its static web (SupportGated.balances), so its restoration of the sustaining need is an instance (SupportGated.repair_restores, with the statement of repair_restores_sustaining_support): within the existing support-gated law, an initially supported contribution route with positive net contribution throughout a deficit-length window keeps its own support and restores the sustaining activity. If both activities lack support, the reached level remains constant despite later nominal contributions. Two actual draw histories have the same initial level and later inputs but opposite recovery outcomes; the recovered history is neither all-time renewing nor permanently consuming, and its supported pulse is an instance of the law (SupportGated.pulse_restores).

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 一个自然数条件、两项按阈值获得支持的活动及既有更新递推。贡献与取用只在焦点活动受支持时实际进入变化，维持更新也只在维持活动受支持时发生。 / One natural-number condition, two threshold-supported activities and the inherited recurrence. Contribution and drawing enter actual change only while the focal activity is supported; sustaining renewal is likewise support-gated.
- 有限恢复结论要求初始修复支持，以及随后 needG − level T 步每步 contrib > draw；这一供给安排及其来源不由定理导出。 / Finite recovery requires initial repair support and contrib > draw at each of the next needG − level T steps; the schedule and its source are supplied.
- 不恢复结论限于两项活动均未获支持、无第三条注入、无阈值修订或条件替代的同一规律；脉冲见证具体给定初值、阈值与输入。 / Non-recovery is restricted to the same law with both activities unsupported, no third injection, threshold revision or condition substitution; pulse witnesses supply exact initial values, thresholds and inputs.

维持、取用与修复是同一展开中分化的作用。旧 Law.level 给出修复窗口起点；每步净增通过 repair_window_progress 接到原维持支持测试。仅第一次取用不同的两段历史改变实际修复支持，后续名义输入并不等于实际供给。没有真实系统的经验对应。 / Sustaining, drawing and repair differentiate roles within one unfolding. The inherited Law.level supplies the repair-window start; per-step progress through repair_window_progress feeds the original sustaining-support test. A first-draw difference changes actual repair support; later nominal inputs are not actual supply. No empirical correspondence to a real system is established.
